document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const slidesWrapper = document.querySelector('.slides-wrapper');
  const prevBtn = document.querySelector('.hero-prev');
  const nextBtn = document.querySelector('.hero-next');
  let currentIndex = 0;
  let isAnimating = false;
  let autoSlideInterval;
  const autoSlideDelay = 6000; // Auto-slide every 6 seconds

  // Function to filter visible slides based on `data-date`
  function filterSlidesByDate() {
    const today = new Date();
    const slides = Array.from(slidesWrapper.children);
    slides.forEach((slide) => {
      const date = slide.getAttribute('data-date');
      if (date) {
        const slideDate = new Date(date);
        if (slideDate < today) {
          slide.style.display = 'none'; // Hide expired slides
        } else {
          slide.style.display = ''; // Show valid slides
        }
      } else {
        slide.style.display = ''; // Show slides without `data-date`
      }
    });
  }

  // Clone first and last visible slides for infinite loop
  function setupInfiniteLoop() {
    const visibleSlides = Array.from(slidesWrapper.children).filter(
      (slide) => slide.style.display !== 'none'
    );
    if (visibleSlides.length < 2) {
      console.warn("Not enough visible slides for infinite loop.");
      prevBtn.style.display = 'none';
      nextBtn.style.display = 'none';
      return visibleSlides; // Return visible slides if loop setup is skipped
    }

    const firstSlide = visibleSlides[0].cloneNode(true);
    const lastSlide = visibleSlides[visibleSlides.length - 1].cloneNode(true);
    slidesWrapper.appendChild(firstSlide);
    slidesWrapper.insertBefore(lastSlide, slidesWrapper.firstChild);

    // Immediately position the wrapper without animation
    slidesWrapper.style.transition = "none";
    slidesWrapper.style.transform = `translateX(-100%)`;

    return visibleSlides;
  }

  // Adjust slide position
  function updateSlidePosition() {
    if (isAnimating) return;
    isAnimating = true;

    const offset = -(currentIndex + 1) * 100; // Adjust for clones
    slidesWrapper.style.transition = 'transform 0.8s ease-in-out';
    slidesWrapper.style.transform = `translateX(${offset}%)`;

    // Handle clones at the edges
    setTimeout(() => {
      const visibleSlides = Array.from(slidesWrapper.children).filter(
        (slide) => slide.style.display !== 'none'
      );
      const totalVisibleSlides = visibleSlides.length;

      if (currentIndex === totalVisibleSlides - 2) {
        currentIndex = 0; // Reset to the first slide
        slidesWrapper.style.transition = 'none';
        slidesWrapper.style.transform = `translateX(-100%)`;
      } else if (currentIndex === -1) {
        currentIndex = totalVisibleSlides - 3; // Reset to the last slide
        slidesWrapper.style.transition = 'none';
        slidesWrapper.style.transform = `translateX(-${totalVisibleSlides - 2}00%)`;
      }
      isAnimating = false;
    }, 800); // Match transition duration
  }

  // Navigation: Show next slide
  function nextSlide() {
    if (isAnimating) return;
    currentIndex += 1;
    updateSlidePosition();
  }

  // Navigation: Show previous slide
  function prevSlide() {
    if (isAnimating) return;
    currentIndex -= 1;
    updateSlidePosition();
  }

  // Auto-slide functionality
  function startAutoSlide() {
    stopAutoSlide(); // Ensure no duplicate intervals
    autoSlideInterval = setInterval(nextSlide, autoSlideDelay);
  }

  function stopAutoSlide() {
    clearInterval(autoSlideInterval);
  }

  // Hover events to pause and resume auto-slide
  slidesWrapper.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoSlide);
  slidesWrapper.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoSlide);

  // Initialize
  filterSlidesByDate();
  const visibleSlides = setupInfiniteLoop();

  // If there are valid visible slides, set up navigation and infinite loop
  if (visibleSlides.length > 1) {
    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', prevSlide);
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', nextSlide);
    startAutoSlide(); // Start auto-sliding
  } else if (visibleSlides.length === 1) {
    // If only one slide is visible, hide navigation buttons
    prevBtn.style.display = 'none';
    nextBtn.style.display = 'none';
  } else {
    console.warn('No valid slides to display.');
  }
});

}

	border-color: #ffffff;
}
.eventmore-content-area:hover .arrow.up {
	border-color: #ffffff;

.collapsible.active {
	border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0;
}
.collapsible.active .more-content-area {
	border-top: 1px solid #cccccc;

}
.event-column {
	text-align: center;
	flex-shrink: 0;
	box-sizing: border-box;
}

.event-column:first-child {
	flex: 0 0 80px;
	/* For On-Demand/Live */

	flex: 0 0 60%;
	/* Title */

	text-align: left;
}

	flex: 0 0 10%;
	/* Date */

	padding-right: 15px;
}
.event-column:nth-child(4) {
	flex: 0 0 15%;
	/* Month + Time */
	text-align: left;
}
.arrow {
	flex-shrink: 0;
	margin-left: auto;
}
.more-content-area {
	padding: 0 18px;
	max-height: 0;
	overflow: hidden;
	transition: max-height 0.2s ease-out, padding 0.2s ease-out;
	width: 100%;
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.more-content-area.expanded {
	padding: 10px 20px 20px 20px;
	border-radius: 0 0 5px 5px;
	max-height: 5000px;
}
.more-content-area p {
	padding: 15px 0;
	margin: 0;
	float:left;
	width:100%;
}
.more-content-area a.button {
	float:left;
}
.more-content-area a.button:hover {
	border:2px solid #d3443d;
}
